env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0
# Pin the default experiment set: the harness passes ambient GOEXPERIMENT
# through, so an inherited nojsonv2 would fail the default run below.
env GOEXPERIMENT=

cd variants

# A JSON type under a disjunctive experiment guard: the source is selected
# both with jsonv2 and with nojsonv2+loopvar. Eject must keep the v1
# lowering buildable without jsonv2 and the v2 methods behind jsonv2.
# The negated guard below is selected under nojsonv2 even without loopvar;
# the helper must still prefer a jsonv2 branch so the v2 methods are kept.
logos run .
stdout '^\{"title":"hello","count":3\}$'
cp stdout $WORK/native-default.txt

env GOEXPERIMENT=nojsonv2,loopvar
logos run .
stdout '^\{"title":"hello","count":3\}$'
stdout '^neg-v1: \{"title":"neg","count":4\}$'
cp stdout $WORK/native-variant.txt
env GOEXPERIMENT=jsonv2,loopvar
logos run .
stdout '^\{"title":"hello","count":3\}$'
stdout '^neg-v1: \{"title":"neg","count":4\}$'
cp stdout $WORK/native-both.txt
env GOEXPERIMENT=

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/data.go
exists out/data_jsonv2.go
grep 'goexperiment.jsonv2' out/data.go
grep 'goexperiment.loopvar' out/data.go
! grep 'jsontext' out/data.go
grep 'jsontext' out/data_jsonv2.go
grep 'goexperiment.jsonv2' out/data_jsonv2.go
exists out/data_neg.go
exists out/data_neg_jsonv2.go
grep 'goexperiment.loopvar' out/data_neg.go
! grep 'jsontext' out/data_neg.go
grep 'jsontext' out/data_neg_jsonv2.go
grep 'goexperiment.jsonv2' out/data_neg_jsonv2.go
cp stream_check.txt out/stream_check_test.go
cp stream_neg_check.txt out/stream_neg_check_test.go

cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-default.txt
go test ./...
env GOEXPERIMENT=nojsonv2,loopvar
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-variant.txt
go test ./...
env GOEXPERIMENT=jsonv2,loopvar
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-both.txt
go test ./...

-- variants/go.mod --
module example.com/jsonvariant

go 1.27

-- variants/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
  v := Data{Title: "hello", Count: 3}
  buf, err := v.MarshalJSON()
  if err != nil {
    fmt.Println("marshal err:", err)
    return
  }
  fmt.Println(string(buf))
}

-- variants/data.lgo --
//go:build goexperiment.jsonv2 || goexperiment.loopvar

package main

type Data struct {
  Title string `json:"title"`
  Count int32  `json:"count"`
}

-- variants/data_neg.lgo --
//go:build !goexperiment.jsonv2 || goexperiment.loopvar

package main

type DataNeg struct {
  Title string `json:"title"`
  Count int32  `json:"count"`
}

-- variants/stream_neg.lgo --
//go:build goexperiment.loopvar

package main

import "fmt"

func init() {
  dn := DataNeg{Title: "neg", Count: 4}
  nbuf, err := dn.MarshalJSON()
  if err != nil {
    fmt.Println("neg marshal err:", err)
    return
  }
  fmt.Println("neg-v1:", string(nbuf))
}

-- variants/stream_check.txt --
//go:build goexperiment.jsonv2

package main

import (
  "bytes"
  "encoding/json"
  "encoding/json/jsontext"
  "strings"
  "testing"
)

func TestStreamRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
  v := Data{Title: "hello", Count: 3}
  var buf bytes.Buffer
  if err := v.MarshalJSONTo(jsontext.NewEncoder(&buf)); err != nil {
    t.Fatal(err)
  }
  flat, err := v.MarshalJSON()
  if err != nil {
    t.Fatal(err)
  }
  // The streaming encoder terminates the value with a newline; the
  // flat bytes carry none. Compare whitespace-insensitively and prove
  // the value round trip in the neg test below.
  if strings.TrimSpace(buf.String()) != string(flat) {
    t.Fatalf("streaming %q != flat %q", buf.String(), flat)
  }
  var m map[string]any
  if err := json.Unmarshal(flat, &m); err != nil {
    t.Fatal(err)
  }
  if m["title"] != "hello" {
    t.Fatalf("decoded title %v", m["title"])
  }
}

-- variants/stream_neg_check.txt --
//go:build goexperiment.jsonv2 && goexperiment.loopvar

package main

import (
  "bytes"
  "encoding/json/jsontext"
  "testing"
)

func TestStreamNegRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
  dn := DataNeg{Title: "neg", Count: 4}
  var buf bytes.Buffer
  if err := dn.MarshalJSONTo(jsontext.NewEncoder(&buf)); err != nil {
    t.Fatal(err)
  }
  var back DataNeg
  if err := back.UnmarshalJSONFrom(jsontext.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(buf.Bytes()))); err != nil {
    t.Fatal(err)
  }
  if back != dn {
    t.Fatalf("round trip %+v != %+v", back, dn)
  }
}
